subject: environmental-science
title: Pollution & Acid Rain: Foundations
welcome_lead: Pollution is anything we add to the environment that harms it.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: air, water, land pollution.
final_note: Spot the source and we're halfway to solving the problem.

concepts.def: Harmful materials added to the environment.
Smoke and gases harming the atmosphere.
Harmful chemicals in rivers, lakes or seas.
Litter and chemicals on the ground.
Tiny solid bits like soot or dust.

walkthroughs.body_html: Cars, factories and burning fuel pump out gases and particulates. Even at low levels, these can damage lungs over time.
Oil spills, sewage and farm chemicals pollute water. Animals die and humans get sick. Plastic waste lasts for centuries.
Litter and old buried waste leak chemicals into soil. Recycling and reusing reduce how much waste reaches landfills.
